lists.content:
• Impact: You will own significant responsibility and have total ownership over your work. We stay lean and efficient, so your work directly impacts the product we ship every day.
  • Simplicity: Complexity is a waste of time here—we take pride in building things that just work.
  • Hard Work: Forget the glamorous research papers. We prioritize the hard work it takes to achieve real-world clarity and accuracy. You will innovate relentlessly to push the boundaries of what’s possible in visual automation.
  • Humility: No task is beneath you. Whether it's high-level architecture or grunt work to fix a bug, we check our egos at the door and get real work done.
  • Ruthless Prioritization: If everything is on fire, nothing is. You will be expected to prioritize ruthlessly, cutting through distractions to focus on the most impactful product improvements.
  • Customer Innovation: We are customer-centric, not customer-pleasing. You won’t bend to every client demand; you will let innovation drive the product forward to solve the real problems our users face.
  • Efficiency: Meetings suck. We keep them short and only use them for alignment, giving you your time back to focus on real work.

• Owning Developer Productivity: Identifying bottlenecks in the Mashgin engineering workflow and architecting LLM-powered solutions to eliminate them.
  • Interviewing engineers to understand their current process and accelerating them 10x.
  • Building Intelligent Tooling: Implementing 0-to-1 systems for automated code refactoring, test generation, and context-aware documentation.
  • Bridging Infrastructure and AI: Architecting and deploying LLM-powered services using both commercial APIs (like Claude) and open-source models.
  • Scaling Workflows: Rethinking and recreating existing internal CI/CD and build processes to integrate AI-driven bug detection and security vulnerability assessments.
  • Prototyping & Shipping: Building simple MVPs of developer tools and shipping them quickly to the team for immediate feedback and iteration.

• 6+ years relevant coding experience
  • B.S. or higher in Computer Science (or equivalent work experience)
  • Excellent knowledge of one or more of these languages: Python, Node.js, C++, Go, C#, Java
  • Comfortable learning new languages, libraries, and frameworks when the solution calls for it
  • Experience building production-ready code that’s used regularly by lots of people

• Experience with LSPs (Language Server Protocols) and IDE integration
  • Experience managing and optimizing large monolithic repositories, including build systems and version control workflows
  • Strong proficiency with SQL and database technologies
  • Knowledge of cloud infrastructure (AWS, Terraform, or similar)

• An opportunity to work on a small, multidisciplinary team with the potential to break new ground in many different industries
  • Excellent health, dental and vision insurance for you and your dependents
  • 401k plan
  • Flexible PTO policy
  • Catered lunch in office with fully stocked snacks and beverages
  • Pet insurance for your fur babies
  • Voluntary life insurance plan
  • Competitive salary and options in a small, rapidly scaling company

Position Summary
This is not a specialized position. We're hiring Builders — people who can wear every hat and ship products that blow people's minds.
 
Most companies split this across five roles: a PM to decide what to build, a designer to figure out how it looks, a frontend engineer, a backend engineer, and someone to handle support when it breaks. We don't do that. At Mashgin, one person owns the whole thing — from talking to a stadium operations manager about their pain points, to sketching a solution, to writing the code that runs on thousands of kiosks, to watching real users interact with it and iterating until it's right.
 
You'll work across our entire stack: the computer vision models running on-device, the kiosk UI that a customer touches, the cloud infrastructure processing a million transactions a day, the dashboards operators use to manage their locations. You'll use AI tools to move at 10x speed, but you'll understand what's happening under the hood.
 
If you could credibly start a company tomorrow and do every job yourself — engineering, design, product, support — you're the kind of person we're looking for.
 
We maintain a flat, high-impact engineering culture where every engineer who joins our team carries the title of Member of Technical Staff.
 
Where We Need Builders Today
Reporting & Management Application. Own the application our customers use to understand their business — reporting dashboards, transaction analytics, location management, and operational tools. This requires a deep understanding of data, visualization, and customer processes. You'll need to get inside the heads of stadium operators, c-store managers, and university dining directors to understand what numbers matter to them and how to surface insights that drive real decisions. Not just charts — the whole product experience around the data.
 
Creator (Menu Management UI). Own Creator, our menu management platform — the tool operators use to configure what their kiosks recognize, how items are priced, and how menus are organized. This is an incredibly complex workflow (think: thousands of SKUs, regional variations, seasonal rotations, tax rules, modifier chains) that needs to feel simple to a normal human end user. If you love the challenge of taking gnarly domain complexity and making it disappear behind an interface that a non-technical operator can use without training, this is your role.

Position Summary

We're looking for an engineer to join a new team building features on top of in-store camera feeds (not the kiosk's own sensors, but the store's security/overhead cameras). Today that footage mostly just sits on-site, unused. This team will build the pipeline to get value out of it, whether that means analyzing it where it lives or pulling it into the cloud, across thousands of stores each with its own network constraints and camera hardware.

You'll be an early member of the team. That means writing the capture/ingestion code, dealing with real codec and streaming decisions (what to encode in, how to transport and play back efficiently over constrained store networks), figuring out what stays on-site versus what moves to the cloud, and getting the first features hooked up. This has a lot in common with building a video player/streaming stack. We need someone who's comfortable with some ambiguity: requirements that aren't fully defined yet, tooling you may need to build yourself, and a willingness to just build the thing rather than wait for a full spec. This is a hands-on coding role first, an infrastructure-design role second.

We maintain a flat, high-impact engineering culture where every engineer who joins our team carries the title of Member of Technical Staff.

lists.content:
• Impact: You will own significant responsibility and have total ownership over your work. We stay lean and efficient, so your work directly impacts the product we ship every day.
  • Simplicity: Complexity is a waste of time here—we take pride in building things that just work.
  • Hard Work: Forget the glamorous research papers. We prioritize the hard work it takes to achieve real-world clarity and accuracy. You will innovate relentlessly to push the boundaries of what’s possible in visual automation.
  • Humility: No task is beneath you. Whether it's high-level architecture or grunt work to fix a bug, we check our egos at the door and get real work done.
  • Ruthless Prioritization: If everything is on fire, nothing is. You will be expected to prioritize ruthlessly, cutting through distractions to focus on the most impactful product improvements.
  • Customer Innovation: We are customer-centric, not customer-pleasing. You won’t bend to every client demand; you will let innovation drive the product forward to solve the real problems our users face.
  • Efficiency: Meetings suck. We keep them short and only use them for alignment, giving you your time back to focus on real work.

• Writing the actual code, end to end, for a 0-to-1 pipeline: capturing feeds from in-store cameras, encoding, and getting that video where it needs to go, whether that's processed on-site or ingested and stored in the cloud, with no existing system to extend
  • Making real codec and streaming-protocol decisions: encoding formats, bitrate/quality tradeoffs, adaptive streaming
  • Making fast, pragmatic calls on architecture with incomplete information, and being fine revisiting them as real-world store conditions prove you wrong
  • Getting the first feature or two working end-to-end (e.g. a monitoring view, or feeding footage into an early AI feature) to prove the pipeline works
  • Working alongside a small, scrappy group across hardware, ML, and backend, figuring out together what "good" looks like, not inheriting a spec
  • Dealing with the reality of store hardware: varying camera models, spotty or shared network connections, and physical sites you can't always control
  • Doing whatever the moment calls for: debugging a flaky store network connection one day, writing a service to process or ship video the next
  • Using AI coding tools to move fast: prototyping quickly, cutting through boilerplate, and iterating on architecture without getting bogged down
    •

• 5+ years relevant coding experience, with a track record of shipping production code yourself. 
  • B.S. or higher in Computer Science (or equivalent work experience)
  • Strong Python, plus comfort picking up whatever language or tool the problem actually needs
  • Hands-on experience with video codecs, encoding, and streaming protocols: video player, media pipeline, or streaming platform work (think the engineering behind a video player at a company like Crunchyroll, Netflix, Twitch, YouTube)
  • Experience touching both sides of a pipeline, edge/device code and cloud services, rather than only one layer
  • Has built something from zero before: a new service, a new team's first system, a 0-to-1 project with no existing scaffolding
  • Comfortable being one of the few people who know how a piece of the system works, at least for a while

• Startup experience, ideally on a small or newly-formed team where you wore multiple hats. 
  • Experience with camera or video hardware in the field (not just cloud-side video), especially dealing with inconsistent hardware or network conditions
  • Comfortable working alongside ML engineers without needing to own the modeling work yourself
  • Knowledge of infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible, etc.) and cloud environments like AWS
  • Good knowledge of algorithms and data structures
  • Fluent with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) as a default part of how you build and prototype
    •

• An opportunity to work on a small, multidisciplinary team with the potential to break new ground in many different industries
  • Excellent health, dental and vision insurance for you and your dependents
  • 401k plan
  • Flexible PTO policy
  • Catered lunch in office with fully stocked snacks and beverages
  • Pet insurance for your fur babies
  • Voluntary life insurance plan
  • Competitive salary and options in a small, rapidly scaling company

lists.content:

  • Continuously improving and maintaining code that’s already in production

  • Experience building production-ready code that’s used regularly by lots of people

• Experience in a fast-paced work environment, shipping quality code quickly and iterating
  • Comfortable with deploying and managing cloud infrastructure
  • Good knowledge of algorithms and data structures
  • Strong proficiency with SQL and other database technologies

• An opportunity to work on a small, multidisciplinary team with the potential to break new ground in many different industries
  • Flexible PTO policy
  • Competitive salary in a rapidly scaling company

lists.content:
• Impact: You will own significant responsibility and have total ownership over your work. We stay lean and efficient, so your work directly impacts the product we ship every day.
  • Simplicity: Complexity is a waste of time here—we take pride in building things that just work.
  • Hard Work: Forget the glamorous research papers. We prioritize the hard work it takes to achieve real-world clarity and accuracy. You will innovate relentlessly to push the boundaries of what’s possible in visual automation.
  • Humility: No task is beneath you. Whether it's high-level architecture or grunt work to fix a bug, we check our egos at the door and get real work done.
  • Ruthless Prioritization: If everything is on fire, nothing is. You will be expected to prioritize ruthlessly, cutting through distractions to focus on the most impactful product improvements.
  • Customer Innovation: We are customer-centric, not customer-pleasing. You won’t bend to every client demand; you will let innovation drive the product forward to solve the real problems our users face.
  • Efficiency: Meetings suck. We keep them short and only use them for alignment, giving you your time back to focus on real work.

• Working with a small interdisciplinary team in hardware, software and design to build new versions of products from scratch
  • Providing technical support and architectural guidance to existing systems and teams on best practices, reviewing implementations, and helping troubleshoot complex issues
  • Build backend infrastructure to perform scalable training in the cloud
  • Rethinking and recreating existing codebases for scale
  • Continuously improving and maintaining code that’s already in production

• 5+ years relevant coding experience
  • B.S. or higher in Computer Science (or equivalent work experience)
  • Python programming with knowledge of infrastructure as code (terraform, ansible,etc)
  • Experience in designing and managing cloud-based environments like AWS
  • Comfortable learning new languages, libraries, and frameworks when the solution calls for it
  • Experience building production-ready code that’s used regularly by lots of people

• Experience in a fast-paced work environment, shipping quality code quickly and iterating
  • Comfortable with deploying and managing cloud infrastructure
  • Good knowledge of algorithms and data structures

• An opportunity to work on a small, multidisciplinary team with the potential to break new ground in many different industries
  • Excellent health, dental and vision insurance for you and your dependents
  • 401k plan
  • Flexible PTO policy
  • Catered lunch in office with fully stocked snacks and beverages
  • Pet insurance for your fur babies
  • Voluntary life insurance plan
  • Competitive salary and options in a small, rapidly scaling company
